presets.title: Cheap 2005 camera phone
presets.prompt: An ordinary candid snapshot from a cheap 2005 mobile phone with soft focus, low resolution, patchy sensor noise, visible JPEG artifacts and awkward handheld framing.

presets.title: Indoor flash
presets.prompt: A spontaneous amateur indoor snapshot with blunt frontal flash, shiny clipped highlights, a dark background, unpredictable white balance and a cheap early-digital color response.

presets.title: Old compact digital camera
presets.prompt: A casual 2004 consumer compact-camera photograph with slightly smeared details, harsh in-camera sharpening, uneven exposure, vivid small-sensor colors and visible JPEG compression.
